 Ads stop the day you stop paying

 Paid clicks for SEO and trade terms in Farnham are expensive, so you have tried ads, and they stop the day you stop paying.
 2 What relying on them costs
 Every month you rely on ads alone, you pay again for customers the map could send you for free.

 AI SEO and GEO
 A mention in an AI answer has no click price 
 For a Farnham firm weighing up ad spend, AI search is one more place buyers ask for recommendations without anyone buying a click. AI SEO looks after Google and AI Overviews, and GEO (generative engine optimisation) looks after assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini. Neither comes as a fixed package; both are priced to scope. A citation cannot be guaranteed, and the same goes for anything about Google's AI answers.
 AI SEO
 Keyword and content strategy built around the questions buyers ask AI
 Pages structured so AI answers can quote them
 Technical foundations: speed, indexing, schema and internal linking
 Plain-English reporting on rankings, citations and enquiries
 GEO (generative engine optimisation)
 Key pages restructured into clear, quotable answers
 Structured data stating your services, prices, location and credentials
 AI crawler access and an llms.txt file
 Consistent business facts across the sources AI models read
 Monthly checks across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and AI Overviews
 Left out on purpose
 Andy will not run your ads for you 
 Your ads stay with you or whoever manages them now. Andy works only on the unpaid side of search in Farnham, which is what keeps the two easy to compare.

 Worth asking
 Ads, the map and what to do first 
 Should I stop my Google Ads?
 Not straight away. Run both for a few months, look at your ad figures beside the map report, and then decide what to keep.
 Is Wrecclesham or Frensham within your patch?
 Yes. Tell Andy which villages you serve and they go on your report.
 Do I need a new website?
 Not always. If the site is the weak link, Farnham website design is Antek's build service for the town, priced from £600.
 Are you an SEO agency in Farnham?
 Antek Automation is one person, Andy Norman, working from Andover. You get him rather than an agency team, and he serves Farnham by phone and video.
 What is GEO, and does it matter if I run ads?
 GEO is generative engine optimisation. It shapes your website and business facts so AI tools such as ChatGPT and Perplexity can read and quote them, which ads do not touch. Being quoted cannot be guaranteed, and the work is priced to scope.
 How is AI SEO connected to map rankings?
 The map draws on your Google profile, reviews and location. AI SEO works on the website, so AI Overviews and similar tools have something clear to quote. Doing both covers more of the places buyers look, with no promise about either.
 Am I tied in?
 Before work starts, the terms are put in writing and agreed with you.
 What does the monthly fee include?
 The LocalFalcon report, review requests and replies, profile posts, profile upkeep and a summary, from £497 a month. That list is what goes into your written scope.

Who you would work with
 Andy Norman, helping Farnham firms rely less on ads 
 Over 30 years in field service and managed print left Andy Norman with a dislike of paying again for something that should have lasted.
 That is the thinking behind his local SEO work for Farnham businesses. Ads have their place, but he would like them to be something you choose each month and not something you cannot afford to switch off.

 You agree a written scope, and then Andy gets on with the map, the profile and the review requests. He reports back once a month in plain words.
